releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Private Locker writing-only, encrypted search/editing, four-digit Diary-style PIN, Pattern, Favourite Name recovery and separate Android Keystore fingerprint. Diary Lock remains unchanged.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 297: Private Locker Lock Off now automatically verifies the entered PIN; correct PIN turns Lock OFF and opens the Locker, while an incorrect PIN shows 'PIN galat hai.' beside the PIN field. Existing encrypted entries and Diary Lock/Note Lock remain unchanged.
